1952.name: X Layer Testnet

XCupBetHook.note: Uniswap V4 Hook (afterSwap). Demonstration deployment uses the deployer wallet as 'PoolManager' so afterSwap can be triggered directly on testnet. Production deployment on X Layer mainnet would use the real V4 PoolManager at 0x360e68faccca8ca495c1b759fd9eee466db9fb32 (chain 196).

1952.note: v2 deploy with variable per-market feeBps (capped at 5%) + settable treasury (admin can call setTreasury to swap to a Safe). XCupBetHook is a Uniswap V4 Hook that routes a fraction of swap output into XCupMarket on every afterSwap callback — 'every trade is implicitly a market bet'. Markets are created lazily per fixture by the API's /admin/* seed endpoints.
